objective: Create a versioned Queensland public-reference birthing profile with exact 2022 aggregate population, onset and route counts and a separately versioned current-policy source registry. Keep staffing, site eligibility decisions, and operational timing targets explicitly unconfigured where public evidence or a site scope does not support them.
steps: Extract only the explicitly tabulated Queensland 2022 maternal/baby population, labour-onset and method-of-birth counts; retain the table population and denominator for every record.

Build a reference-only versioned JSON profile. Separate observed aggregates, current policy-source metadata and synthetic assumptions; record not-configured states for staffing, site eligibility and operational timing targets where no site-scoped value is supported.

Check current Queensland Clinical Guideline index/history for policy-source identity and revision as of 2026-10-27. Record source applicability boundaries and do not translate clinical observation intervals into service targets.
Run packet validation, profile integrity assertions, task/context checks and diff checks; record exact command/output hashes and source limits.
Obtain reviewer-agent review of the exact implementation commit and address any findings before coordinator acceptance.

verification.oracle: Packet schema, B0.1 dependency and bound input hashes validate.

argv: import json,pathlib; p=json.loads(pathlib.Path('model-inputs/birthing/profiles/qld-public-reference-2022-v1.json').read_text()); assert p['schema_version']==1 and p['profile_status']=='reference_only'; assert p['population']['mothers']['count']==60477 and p['population']['babies']['count']==61404; assert sum(x['count'] for x in p['population']['previous_pregnancies']['categories'])==60477; assert sum(x['count'] for x in p['population']['plurality']['categories'])==60477; assert sum(x['count'] for x in p['population']['maternal_age']['categories'])==60477; assert sum(x['count'] for x in p['routes']['births_by_method'])==61404; assert sum(x['count'] for x in p['labour_onset']['mothers_by_category'])==60477; assert next(s for s in p['sources']['policy_registry'] if s['source_id']=='qcg_intrapartum_fetal_surveillance_mn25_15_v12_r30')['identifier']=='MN25.15-V12-R30'; assert p['staffing']['status']=='unavailable_as_public_parameter'; assert p['eligibility']['status']=='not_encoded_without_site_scope'; assert p['operational_timing_targets']['status']=='unconfigured_without_site_scope'
verification.oracle: Versioned profile parses, observed cohort totals reconcile, and unsupported site-level parameters remain explicitly unconfigured.
The new local profile/evidence links resolve and Conductor context remains valid.

acceptance: Observed population/onset counts use the Queensland 2022 aggregate tables with correct mother versus baby denominators; method-of-birth categories reconcile to the reported baby count.

The profile records its data year, source edition, jurisdiction, units, population scope and reference-only status; no observed percentages are transformed into individual-level hazards or a runnable default.

Current Queensland policy references are versioned independently from 2022 observed data. Staffing, eligibility rules and operational timing targets are explicit unresolved/unconfigured fields rather than invented values.

The profile documents selected-table cross-tab limitations, changing collection forms, absent staffing data, source scope and unresolved correlations; prior 30/75-minute and parity/duration hypotheses are not adopted.
Reviewer-agent/subagent has reviewed the exact implementation commit and all findings have been addressed before coordinator acceptance.
stop_conditions: A denominator or source table scope cannot be reconciled
A policy rule would need a site or clinical decision not present in the authorized scope
A missing staffing/target field would have to be replaced with an invented value
Any edit escapes the exact write paths
